title: Scalar compatible derived Hom boundary on any open union
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and E,E\prime objects of D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. Assume the derived categories on X and all its localized open sites exist in a common Hom universe. For opens U,V and integer k, write R_A for derived localized-site restriction [lem-sc-derived-hom-mayer-vietoris]. There exists an additive boundary delta:Hom(R_(U intersect V) E,R_(U intersect V)(E\prime[k-1])) -> Hom(R_(U union V) E,R_(U union V)(E\prime[k])). Every morphism on the union whose two canonical restrictions vanish is in the image of delta. For every global function r with action [def-sc-derived-global-scalar] and overlap morphism gamma, delta(R_(U intersect V)(r id_E) composed with gamma)=R_(U union V)(r id_E) composed with delta(gamma). No support, perfectness or quasi-coherence condition is imposed.

source.place: Tag 08BW, negative Ext boundary, with scalar naturality used in Tag 08EJ

proof.text: Use [lem-pc-open-derived-localization-adjunction] to choose a right adjoint G_T of each localized derived restriction R_T, with an adjunction. These choices are of right adjoints, determined up to the adjunction-compatible natural isomorphism. Apply [lem-sc-derived-open-union-adjunction-triangle] to E′ and k, obtaining its inverse-rotated direct-image triangle with the restriction arrow b constructed explicitly from the union counit. Retirement API reconciliation (E6): For each open W use the upstream open_derived_localization_adjunction X W, the adjunction component of [lem-pc-open-derived-localization-adjunction], to choose G_W and its adjunction. The existing ambient and localized-site instances are exactly its hypotheses; no localization on the open subscheme is needed for this step.

Prove compatibility of derivedOpenHomRestriction with precomposition using functoriality and naturality of the canonical comparison isomorphism. Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm and cancellation of homEquiv with its inverse show that the two projections of b transpose to the canonical restrictions. These computations are the proved private helpers restriction_precomp, derived_restriction_precomp and transpose_restriction.

The proved private helper boundary_of_adjunction_triangle takes Hom from E into the triangle. Define the additive boundary by transporting postcomposition with d through the two additive adjunction bijections. If the two restrictions of beta vanish, the two components of its transpose composed with b vanish; biproduct extensionality gives zero. Mathlib Triangle.coyoneda_exact₂ gives a lift, which transports back to gamma. Naturality of both adjunction bijections and associativity prove equivariance for every endomorphism of E; specialize to schemeDerivedScalar X r (identity E), as defined in [def-sc-derived-global-scalar].

proof_origin.note: Covariant Hom into the Tag 08BV direct-image triangle. All restriction, additive-boundary, Hom exactness and source-naturality calculations proved in Lean; geometric distinguishedness isolated as one strictly smaller theorem without any source E or scalar r.

theorem derived_open_hom_scalar_mayer_vietoris
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (U V : X.Opens) (E E' : schemeDerivedCategory X) (k : ℤ) :
    let R := fun W : X.Opens ↦
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) W).mapDerivedCategory
    ∃ δ : ((R (U ⊓ V)).obj E ⟶ (R (U ⊓ V)).obj (E'⟦k - 1⟧)) →+
        ((R (U ⊔ V)).obj E ⟶ (R (U ⊔ V)).obj (E'⟦k⟧)),
      (∀ β : (R (U ⊔ V)).obj E ⟶ (R (U ⊔ V)).obj (E'⟦k⟧),
        derivedOpenHomRestriction X.toRingedSpace (homOfLE le_sup_left) β = 0 →
        derivedOpenHomRestriction X.toRingedSpace (homOfLE le_sup_right) β = 0 →
        ∃ γ, δ γ = β) ∧
      ∀ (r : RingCat.sectionsSubring (X.sheaf.obj ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat.{u})) γ,
        δ ((R (U ⊓ V)).map (schemeDerivedScalar X r (𝟙 E)) ≫ γ) =
          (R (U ⊔ V)).map (schemeDerivedScalar X r (𝟙 E)) ≫ δ γ
